label: additional terms differ from conflicting terms
explanation: Bayway applies subsection (2)’s material-alteration exception to an addition. Northrop confronts the separate textual problem of terms that conflict with the offer.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 284–294. Open assigned page 284.
